Draconic Aspect
30% of base mana
0.5 sec cast
Unleash your Draconic Aspect, increasing your spell damage by 30% of your Intellect and your critical damage with spells by 50%.

While active, dealing direct damage to an enemy inflicts the target with Dragon's Wrath.
Dragon's Wrath
Unleash your wrath, dealing 9+0+FireP*0.3 Fire Damage to your target, piercing all resistances and absorption effects.
